<documents>
<document id="fx-fees-plus-v2">
ForeignˆtransactionˆfeesˆonˆPlusˆOnˆtheˆPlusˆplan,ˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆisˆ1%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆinˆUSˆdollars.ˆ##ˆWhenˆitˆappliesˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrency,ˆinˆaˆstoreˆorˆonlineˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆprocessedˆbyˆaˆmerchantˆoutsideˆtheˆUSˆItˆdoesn'tˆapplyˆtoˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆabroad.ˆThoseˆhaveˆtheˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆinstead.ˆ##ˆExampleˆIfˆaˆpurchaseˆconvertsˆtoˆaˆgivenˆdollarˆamount,ˆtheˆfeeˆisˆ1%ˆofˆthatˆamount.ˆIt'sˆaddedˆasˆaˆseparateˆlineˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆcalledˆ"Foreignˆtransactionˆfee",ˆonˆtheˆsameˆdayˆtheˆpurchaseˆsettles.ˆ##ˆExchangeˆrateˆWeˆuseˆtheˆcardˆnetwork'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆtransactionˆsettles,ˆwithˆnoˆmarkup.ˆChooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆwhenˆaˆterminalˆoffersˆtoˆchargeˆyouˆinˆdollars.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆIfˆaˆforeignˆpurchaseˆisˆrefunded,ˆweˆalsoˆrefundˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆonˆtheˆrefundedˆamount.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆconvertedˆatˆtheˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆitˆsettles.ˆIfˆyouˆtravelˆoften,ˆPremiumˆhasˆnoˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="fee-changes-2026">
WhatˆchangedˆinˆtheˆMarchˆ2026ˆfeeˆupdateˆWeˆupdatedˆourˆfeesˆonˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆHere'sˆeverythingˆthatˆchangedˆandˆwhatˆstayedˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangedˆ-ˆ**Plusˆmonthlyˆfee:**ˆfromˆ$4.00ˆtoˆ$5.00.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆfromˆ1.5%ˆtoˆ1%.ˆ-ˆ**Out-of-networkˆATMˆfeeˆonˆBasicˆandˆPlus:**ˆfromˆ$2.00ˆtoˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawals:**ˆfromˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆWhatˆstayedˆtheˆsameˆBasicˆisˆstillˆfree.ˆPremiumˆisˆstillˆ$15.00ˆaˆmonthˆwithˆnoˆATMˆorˆforeignˆtransactionˆfees.ˆCardˆreplacement,ˆwireˆandˆcashˆdepositˆfeesˆdidn'tˆchangeˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhyˆweˆmadeˆtheseˆchangesˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆoperatorsˆraisedˆwhatˆtheyˆchargeˆus,ˆandˆweˆmovedˆpartˆofˆthatˆcostˆintoˆtheˆfee.ˆWeˆloweredˆtheˆPlusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆatˆtheˆsameˆtime,ˆsoˆPlusˆmembersˆwhoˆtravelˆpayˆlessˆoverall.ˆIfˆtheˆnewˆPlusˆpriceˆdoesn'tˆworkˆforˆyou,ˆyouˆcanˆmoveˆtoˆBasicˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffectˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="travel-exchange-rates">
ExchangeˆratesˆweˆuseˆWhenˆyouˆpayˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrency,ˆweˆconvertˆtheˆamountˆtoˆUSˆdollarsˆusingˆtheˆcardˆnetwork'sˆexchangeˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆtransactionˆsettles.ˆWeˆdon'tˆaddˆaˆmarkupˆtoˆthatˆrate.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆpayˆonˆtopˆYourˆplan'sˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆisˆaddedˆasˆaˆpercentageˆofˆtheˆconvertedˆamount:ˆ-ˆBasic:ˆ3%ˆ-ˆPlus:ˆ1%ˆ-ˆPremium:ˆ0%ˆ##ˆWhyˆtheˆamountˆchangesˆAˆpendingˆtransactionˆshowsˆanˆestimateˆbasedˆonˆtheˆrateˆwhenˆyouˆpaid.ˆTheˆfinalˆamountˆusesˆtheˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆitˆsettles,ˆusuallyˆaˆdayˆorˆtwoˆlater,ˆsoˆitˆcanˆmoveˆslightlyˆupˆorˆdown.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrencyˆIfˆaˆforeignˆmerchantˆrefundsˆyou,ˆweˆconvertˆtheˆrefundˆatˆtheˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆitˆsettles.ˆThatˆcanˆbeˆaˆlittleˆmoreˆorˆlessˆthanˆyouˆoriginallyˆpaid.ˆWeˆrefundˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆonˆtheˆrefundedˆpart.ˆTheˆfeeˆappliesˆtoˆpurchasesˆmadeˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrency,ˆandˆtoˆpurchasesˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆprocessedˆbyˆaˆmerchantˆoutsideˆtheˆUS.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: What's the foreign transaction fee on Plus right now?
